correction_notes: Unsupported uv build --locked exited2; corrected supported build succeeded and a final archive was rebuilt after benchmark tooling fixes.
Corrupt persisted root/ignore/large-integer data exposed exceptions; validation and bounded SQLite guards now fall back without modifying the task.
The development grader accepted zero-exit processes without executed tests; evidence-of-test execution and skip/failure checks were added before formal evaluation.
Runner fidelity/resume/orphan/receipt hardening was added after the initial whole suite; only the final whole suite supplies current distinct totals.

compiled_assets.aggregate_algorithm: sha256 of sorted relative_path + NUL + file_sha256 + LF, UTF-8

source_identity.scope: Current bytes at validation report generation; package audit establishes audited archive/source equivalence at build time. Initial suite and historical review snapshots are separately identified; benchmark/tooling-only changes require the final suite. No assertion that later report/evidence additions existed in an earlier sdist.

privacy.omitted: Browser config/environment and arbitrary diagnostic message/stack/body content; original JUnit parameter names replaced by SHA-256 identities. Outcomes/counts/durations/retries retained.

measurement_limits: This is application/tooling validation, not an A/B result.
Installed fake native execution is an integration check, not an authenticated Codex model request.
Planning token estimates in component/API receipts are not actual model usage.
Command durations that were not recorded remain null with an unavailable reason.
Actual billing/cost per success and full model-call/OS-read counts are not established by these checks.
